map.输入数据集规模与批次大小，计算每轮训练步数，适用于训练循环实现、步数对齐与分布式: Enter the dataset size and batch size to compute the steps per epoch, for training loop implementation, step alignment, and verifying distributed sharding.
map.每卡步数 = ⌈样本数 / 批量⌉；每步覆盖样本 = 批量 × 卡数: Steps per GPU = ⌈samples / batch⌉; samples covered per step = batch × number of GPUs
map.多卡数据并行时，全局批量 = 单卡批量 × 卡数，每卡步数不变但每步实际看到的样: With data parallelism across GPUs, the global batch equals the per-GPU batch times the GPU count, so the steps per GPU stay the same while the samples per step multiply by the GPU count. To keep the effective training strength after adding GPUs, raise the learning rate proportionally or add epochs.
map.每轮步数 steps=⌈数据集样本数/batch_size⌉，决定单轮迭代次数。: Steps per epoch = ⌈dataset samples / batch_size⌉, which sets the number of iterations in one epoch.
map.分布式下每卡步数=⌈N/(batch×world_size)⌉，注意尾批与丢弃策: In distributed training, steps per GPU = ⌈N/(batch×world_size)⌉; watch the tail batch and the drop policy.
map.步数×单步耗时≈单轮时长，是训练排期与进度估算的基础。: Steps × time per step ≈ epoch duration, the basis for scheduling training and estimating progress.
map.：N=50000, batch=64 → steps=⌈50000/64⌉=78: : N = 50000 and batch = 64 give steps = ⌈50000/64⌉ = 782 steps per epoch. With 4 GPUs at batch 64 each, every GPU still runs 782 steps (the total sample count is unchanged) and the effective batch of 256 speeds up convergence.
map.分布式每卡步数变少吗？: Does Each GPU Get Fewer Steps in Distributed Training?
map.若每卡 batch 不变，每卡处理的样本数减少，步数按每卡样本算会减少；总计算量: If the per-GPU batch stays the same, each GPU processes fewer samples and the step count computed per GPU drops; the total work is unchanged — it is simply parallelized faster and the effective batch is larger.
map.尾批怎么影响步数？: How Does the Tail Batch Affect the Step Count?
map.向上取整已含尾批(不足 batch 的余量)。若启用 drop_last 则步数: Rounding up already accounts for the tail batch (the remainder short of a full batch). If drop_last is enabled, steps = ⌊N/batch⌋, which omits the incomplete batch and must be handled accordingly in the metrics.
